items.title: Submit list of stolen items and purchase receipts to insurer
items.quote: Senden Sie uns die Stehlgutliste und die Kaufbelege bitte spätestens 10 Werktage nach dem Datum dieses Briefes; Werktage sind dabei Montag bis Samstag ohne die gesetzlichen Feiertage.
items.computation: Letter is dated Monday, 20.07.2026. The period is expressed as running 'nach dem Datum dieses Briefes' (after the letter's date), so under §187 Abs. 1 BGB counting starts the next day: Tuesday 21.07.2026 = day 1. The letter defines 'Werktage' itself as Monday through Saturday excluding statutory public holidays (so Sundays are skipped, Saturdays count). Counting: day1 Tue 21.07, day2 Wed 22.07, day3 Thu 23.07, day4 Fri 24.07, day5 Sat 25.07, (Sun 26.07 skipped - not a Werktag), day6 Mon 27.07, day7 Tue 28.07, day8 Wed 29.07, day9 Thu 30.07, day10 Fri 31.07.2026. No NRW public holidays fall in this window. Day 10 therefore is Friday, 31.07.2026, which is also not a Saturday/Sunday/holiday itself, so no further shift is needed.

items.title: File the stolen-items list with the police for inclusion in the search/wanted list
items.quote: Die Liste reichen Sie bitte auch bei der Polizei ein, damit die Gegenstände in die Fahndung aufgenommen werden.
items.computation: The letter asks that the same list also be submitted to the police, but gives no specific date or deadline for this step (unlike the 10-Werktage deadline set for the insurer). Since no period or date is stated, no exact due date can be computed; it should logically be done promptly, around the same time as sending the list to the insurer.

warnings: The letter gives no deadline for filing the stolen-items list with the police, so no exact due date could be determined for that step; the person should do it as soon as possible, ideally alongside sending the documents to the insurer.
